package.name: arduino_nano_interface
package.description: ROS 2 interface node for the Arduino Nano hover/power system on Grace robot. Reads ultrasonic proximity (4 directions), dual-battery voltage and current, dual gas sensors (MQ + MH-MQ), and dual charger adapter relay state. Publishes: /nano/ultrasonic /nano/gas /nano/power /nano/charger_relay Subscribes: /nano/relay_command (relay control) Logs gas and power data to CSV and Supabase.
package.author: Muhammad Anss
